name: Samon
source:
Zashiki-Warashi - House Spirit

Weakness: Being called a "boy"

"You're too defenseless. I'm an ayakashi too, you know."

He's hid his ayakashi identity while watching over you all this time. Behind his sweet and gentle character lies a hidden passionate side...

"I...never really thought of you as a sister."

Miyabi: "He's a guy who'll only love one woman his whole life, but he lacks nerve."
Shinra: "Normally he plays peacemaker, but he steps up when things get intense."

[From [url=https://voltageapps.com/love365/apps/enchanted-in-the-moonlight/]English official site[/url]]
